answer: Because the pearl solution is checked at the umber gate and logged, the haven audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 19 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
